note: Exact replay of the rules (five agreeing samples, hold 300 s, no margin) on five development rotations and both validation videos, largest detector. `cattle` is the three cattle networks alone, taught and scored by the application's code. `animal` is one MIEWid network adapted by animal_trial.py, alone. `mixed` averages the two kinds photograph by photograph before a cow's two nearest photographs are taken; `kinds` lets each kind take its own two nearest and averages the two scores, which is what the application does. In this comparison the three withheld cows count as strangers in the development videos as well.
